conditions: Measurements from one South Korean steel facility
Quarter-hour source intervals; use previous measurements only for a rolling next-interval forecast
limitations: No human action, error or recovery outcome
Same-interval power factors and load labels are excluded from forecasting
The CO2 column has inconsistent source unit labels and is not used
Day-ending midnight labels require explicit clock interpretation; raw dates remain preserved and timing claims are conditional on this assumption.
steel_energy.interpretation: Rolling one-interval forecast with genuinely available earlier measurements; not a whole-quarter open-loop forecast. Same-interval reactive power, carbon quantity, power factors and load type are excluded.
steel_energy.source_timezone: unspecified source civil time; not assumed UTC
